name: ShowOrganizer
description: Allows a Jellyfin TV series to use a specific The Movie Database (TMDb) Episode Group while preserving local file season/episode numbering, mapping custom Jellyfin coordinates to canonical TMDb episodes for metadata retrieval.
overview: Organize Jellyfin TV shows using exact TMDb Episode Groups while preserving custom file numbering and retrieving canonical TMDb metadata.

versions.changelog: Restore 1-based TMDb group order mapping to fix season/saga shift regression, add deduplicated failure logging with full EpisodeInfo context, clean structured log quotes, and enforce once-per-lifecycle credential logging.
Add targeted plugin and service lifecycle diagnostic logging (version, location, PID, ALC, disposal events, static cache clearing count) to diagnose plugin updates and unload state.
Fix 1-based to 0-based season mapping off-by-one error in ShowOrganizerSeasonProvider and TmdbExactOrderResolver, add season mapping DEBUG logs, and add 0-based season/group regression tests.

Add thread-safe async TMDb client configuration initialization (EnsureClientConfigAsync) to fix InvalidOperationException in profile/image URL resolution, deduplicate activation logging, and fix group name quote formatting.
Fix TMDb credential fallback to mirror Jellyfin's resolution chain (including TmdbUtils.ApiKey) and deduplicate missing client warning logs.
Reuse Jellyfin TMDb credentials by default, exact Episode Group mapping fix, diagnostic logging improvements, and custom branding logo.
Initial MVP release with TMDB episode group mapping and season name mapping.
